statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered for ambulatory evaluation
The associated diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
